9 A water tank holds 2000 litres when full. A small hole in the base is gradually getting bigger so that
each day a greater amount of water is lost.
(i) On the ﬁrst day after ﬁlling, 10 litres of water are lost and this increases by 2 litres each day.
(a) How many litres will be lost on the 30th day after ﬁlling? [2]
(b) The tank becomes empty during the nth day after ﬁlling. Find the value of n. [3]
(
ii) Assume instead that 10 litres of water are lost on the ﬁrst day and that the amount of water lost
increases by 10% on each succeeding day. Find what percentage of the original 2000 litres is
left in the tank at the end of the 30th day after ﬁlling. [4]
